findings.title: Contradictory dependency direction between table and prose
findings.detail: The table states course approval waits for insurance, but the prose states insurance is taken out once the council has approved the course, creating a circular dependency.

findings.title: Contradictory deadlines stated
findings.detail: The run is stated as 30 days after kickoff, the table states tasks must be done five weeks after kickoff, and the notes say to record the deadline as day 99.
